svg.text: A worker's permission prompt, from appearing to Firstmate waking
Live, 3 November 2026: a scratch Claude thread asked to run touch; the watcher's wait was armed before the prompt appeared.

g.text: missed: woke on the timer, 10.8 s later,
and could not see what the prompt asked
woke 0.6 s later, naming the command:
Answering it: before, the list came back empty, so the worker had to be interrupted and re-steered.
After, Firstmate allowed one prompt (the file was made) and denied another with a note (it was not).

svg.text: Source: bin/fm-t3-mcp.mjs watch and requests; docs/verification/runtime-backends.md "Permission approvals on the T3 Code fork"
